In this QSG, you will learn how to: * Download and install the {{variable.Product_Payments}} app. * Assign Licenses (if in production). * Assign Permission Sets. * Setup your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}(s). * Stripe * Authorize.net * Spreedly * Set up {{variable.Product_PayLink}}, {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}, and {{variable.Product_DocumentLink}}. * Move historical data to Blackthorn. * Set up FSL (optional). * Go live in production.
